task: Upgrade Falco from 0.39.2 (chart 4.16.0, disabled since 2026-07-08) to 0.45.1 (chart 9.2.1) and enable it on every provider (owner decision 2026-10-28), then fix the independent review (FAIL) of PR #503: the Alertmanager v1 endpoint, the falcosidekick version, the portal's Ubuntu 26.04 gating of the Runtime Events tab and two documentation errors. Scope of this change: repository chart values, image/chart/inventory/SBOM pins, the portal Loki reader seam and Runtime Events tab, docs and regression updates. The orchestrator does the live chart publish, image mirroring and GitOps push after merge. Falco on the Ubuntu 26.04 / kernel 7.0 Vagrant box is NOT verified.

events.summary: Rewrite the falco Application for chart 9.2.1 / Falco 0.45.1 and remove its if-false guard; keep modern_ebpf, resources and the privileged DaemonSet; make it airgap-safe (falcoctl install and follow off, the container plugin and falco-rules come from the image); bump images.txt, image-digests.tsv, component-licenses.tsv, chart-upstream-sources.tsv, the SBOM review map, VERSIONS.md, the compatibility matrix, both gitops READMEs, NOTICE and CHANGELOGs; drop the Ubuntu 26.04 falco exclusion from 14-gitops-bootstrap.sh; fix the portal Loki reader; add R291 (check-falco.py --mutation-verify). Review pass on PR #503: post Alertmanager alerts to /api/v2/alerts, run falcosidekick 2.35.0 instead of the subchart's 2.32.0 (D-FALCO-SIDEKICK), remove the portal's Ubuntu 26.04 gating of the Runtime Events tab with its i18n text and update the KISA control notes, refresh the portal Loki fixture from falcosidekick 2.35.0, correct the lessons-log row about 01-generate-image-list.sh, and fully qualify upstream issue and PR references in the changed Markdown. Deliberately left alone: the falco and falcosidekick resources (the 512Mi limit predates this change and the orchestrator measures live memory), 01-generate-image-list.sh, Kyverno and PSA (no change needed), and portal/scripts/harness-rules.sh, which reports hardcoded Korean 66 against a baseline of 48 both here and at origin/main 23f016c8. No cluster, ssh, vagrant, helm install or push was used.

Falco 0.39.2 modern_ebpf fails scap_init on a kernel 7.0.14 VM and 0.45.1 does not. Reproduced 2026-10-27 on a local Docker Desktop VM (Linux 7.0.14-linuxkit aarch64, BTF present): docker.io/falcosecurity/falco-no-driver:0.39.2 run privileged with -o engine.kind=modern_ebpf exits 1 with 'An error occurred in an event source, forcing termination... Error: Initialization issues during scap_init', the same signature as the 2026-07-08 Vagrant failure; docker.io/falcosecurity/falco:0.45.1 on the same VM opens the modern BPF probe. Upstream attributes the 7.0 breakage to libs fixes absent from 0.39.2 (libs 0.18.2) and present in 0.45.1 (libs 0.26.1): falcosecurity/libs#2997 execve verifier count, falcosecurity/libs#3021 sendmmsg bpf_loop, falcosecurity/libs#3086 auxmap race on preemptible kernels (falcosecurity/falco#3955; reporters on Ubuntu 26.04 kernels 7.0.0-27 and 7.0.0-28, and on 7.0.0-31, confirm 0.45.0-rc1), falcosecurity/libs#3119 signal_deliver verifier. Seam defects found while reading the portal reader against real output: falcosidekick's Loki priority label is Capitalized (portal selected lowercase), Loki lines are JSON only with loki.format=json (default text is dropped by the portal), source=falco exists only on Alertmanager alerts, metrics.outputRule emits an hourly snapshot event into the portal feed, and the removed collectors.containerd key is silently ignored by chart 9.x.

events.summary: Alertmanager v1 endpoint defect, reproduced 2026-10-28 in a local Docker lab against the real quay.io/prometheus/alertmanager:v0.33.0 (the version and digest pinned in images.txt and image-digests.tsv). falcosidekick subchart 0.14.1 renders ALERTMANAGER_ENDPOINT=/api/v1/alerts, which overrides falcosidekick's own default; Alertmanager removed the v1 API in 0.27.0 and answers 410. With that env, falcosidekick (2.32.0 and 2.35.0) logs 'AlertManager - unexpected Response (410)' and 'AlertManager - 410 Gone' for a Critical event and the event never appears in GET /api/v2/alerts, so every Critical alert is dropped. With ALERTMANAGER_ENDPOINT=/api/v2/alerts the same event logs 'AlertManager - POST OK (200)' and GET /api/v2/alerts lists it with source=falco. The portal's own reader already calls ${ALERTMANAGER_URL}/api/v2/alerts on the same Service, and the kube-prometheus-stack Application sets no route prefix.

events.summary: falco.yaml now targets chart 9.2.1 with explicit image pins (falco 0.45.1; falcosidekick 2.35.0 as the D-FALCO-SIDEKICK override of the subchart's 2.32.0; both docker.io because ghcr.io and quay.io do not host them), modern_ebpf, falcoctl off, collectors.containerEngine with only the CRI engine on /run/containerd/containerd.sock, loki.format json, alertmanager.endpoint /api/v2/alerts, metrics.outputRule false, and release=prometheus-stack on both ServiceMonitors (Prometheus only selects labelled monitors). The old falco.grpc, falco.grpc_output, collectors.containerd and k8s_audit_rules.yaml entries and the inert loki.tenantmap and alertmanager.expirealert keys are gone; resources are unchanged from origin/main. Airgap inventories (images.txt, image-digests.tsv with the 2.35.0 index digest), SBOM review map, VERSIONS.md and the compatibility matrix carry the same pins; 14-gitops-bootstrap.sh no longer removes falco on Ubuntu 26.04; NOTICE no longer calls Falco an unlisted component.

D-FALCO-SIDEKICK: falcosidekick runs 2.35.0 instead of the 2.32.0 that subchart 0.14.1 ships. 2.32.0 predates falcosecurity/falcosidekick#1366 (vulnerable Go modules, released in 2.34.0) and falcosecurity/falcosidekick#1390 (race when several outputs are configured, released in 2.35.0; Loki and Alertmanager are both enabled here). 2.35.0 (2026-08-31) is the newest release past the 7-day cooling window; 2.35.1 (2026-10-26) becomes eligible on 2026-11-02. The contract is unchanged for this deployment: outputs/loki.go and types/priority.go are identical in 2.32.0 and 2.35.0, the only alert-payload change is an extra alertname label (the Falco rule), and the rest of outputs/alertmanager.go is json.Number decoding. The old VERSIONS.md reason for 2.32.0 (a cooling window) was wrong and is replaced. Cost: an image override the subchart was not released against. Escape hatch: set the tag back to 2.32.0 (the v2 endpoint stays) or move to 2.35.1 on or after 2026-11-02 after re-running the lab and R291.

falcosidekick.config.alertmanager.endpoint is set to /api/v2/alerts in falco.yaml, so Critical alerts reach Alertmanager 0.27 and later instead of being dropped with 410. The portal Security page no longer hides the Runtime Events tab on Ubuntu 26.04: detectUbuntu2604, the is2604 gating and both security.runtimeEvents.unavailable2604 i18n keys are removed, so the tab is shown on every provider now that Falco is enabled everywhere. kisa-controls.ts no longer says Falco is disabled; it names Falco 0.45.1 and D-FALCO-045 and states that cluster behaviour is not part of the evidence. cache-keys.ts no longer lists the security page as a reader of cluster:{id}:infra (clusterCacheKey(clusterId, 'infra') is now used only by src/app/api/cluster/route.ts). R291 assertion A7 requires that the page has no 26.04 or osImage gating and keeps the runtime TabsTrigger and TabsContent, and two mutations (re-gating on 26.04, dropping the trigger) are each caught by A7.
